summary: Hiker fell on the Southwest Approach to Ellingwood Point after a Garmin SOS activation; leg pinned by a large boulder and severely broke his arm; immobile in steep loose terrain; extracted by Colorado National Guard hoist, transferred to REACH 71/GUARDIAN 1 and flown to the front range
notes: Run 827 insert: parent-opened AVSAR post; Garmin SOS + Guard hoist + air-medical transfer.
